[[Jio Payments Bank]] (77%) | owners = [[Mukesh Ambani|Ambani family]] (47.12%){{cite news |title=Jio Financial Services shares: JFS arm gets CARE's stable rating on bank facilities |url=https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks/story/jio-financial-services-shares-jfs-arm-gets-cares-stable-rating-on-bank-facilities-435239-2024-07-01 |access-date=27 September 2024 |work=Business Today |date=1 July 2024 |language=en}} | website = {{url|https://www.jfs.in/}} {{url|https://www.jiofinance.in/}} }} '''Jio Financial Services Ltd''' (JFSL) is an Indian [[Financial services|financial services company]], based in [[Mumbai]]. Originally a subsidiary of [[Reliance Industries]] (RIL), it was [[demerged]] as an independent entity and listed on the [[Indian stock exchange (disambiguation)|Indian stock exchanges]] in August 2023.{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/jio-financial-services-to-be-listed-on-stock-exchanges-on-august-21-11692348058819.html|title=Jio Financial Services to be listed on stock exchanges on August 21|first=Ankit|last=Gohel|date=18 August 2023|website=mint}} The company provides financial services, including payment services and insurance broking.{{Cite web|url=https://indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/banking-financials-jio-financial-services-decoding-the-unknown-1692594508799_1.html|title=Banking & Financials: Jio Financial Services: Decoding the unknown|website=indiainfoline.com}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/jio-financial-services-to-provide-simple-affordable-solutions-mukesh-ambani-393001-2023-08-06|title=Jio Financial Services to provide simple, affordable solutions: Mukesh Ambani|date=6 August 2023|website=Business Today}} Its subsidiary Jio Finance holds an [[Non-bank financial institution|NBFC]] license from the [[Reserve Bank of India|RBI]]. Another subsidiary, [[Jio Payments Bank]], is also a [[payments bank]] registered in India. == History == Jio Financial Services was initially a financial services subsidiary of [[Reliance Industries]]. In July 2023, it was spun-off via a [[demerger]], with shareholders of Reliance Industries receiving one equity share of Jio Financial Services for every share they held in Reliance.{{Cite web |last=Jauhari |first=Ujjval |date=2023-07-20 |title=Reliance demerger: Jio Financial Services valued at ₹261.85 |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/reliance-demerger-jio-financial-services-valued-at-rs-261-85-surpasses-analysts-estimates-11689828067155.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230823213323/https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/reliance-demerger-jio-financial-services-valued-at-rs-261-85-surpasses-analysts-estimates-11689828067155.html |archive-date=2023-08-23 |access-date=2024-02-16 |website=mint |language=en}} Reliance Industries transferred {{INRConvert|15500|c}} of cash and liquid investments to Jio Financial Services as part of the demerger scheme. This gave Jio Financial Services a liquid asset base of {{INRConvert|20700|c}}.{{Cite web |date=24 July 2023 |title=Reliance Industries shifts Rs 15,500 crore to Jio Financial Services |url=https://www.financialexpress.com/industry/reliance-industries-shifts-rs-15500-crore-to-jio-financial-services/3183700/}} JFSL was listed on the stock exchanges on 21 August 2023. Following the demerger and listing, JFSL was briefly a part of [[Nifty 50]], [[BSE SENSEX]] and FTSE indices, but was removed from these indices over the following weeks as it did not meet their inclusion criteria.{{Cite web |date=31 August 2023 |title=Jio Financial Services to be removed from BSE Indices from September 1 |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/jio-financial-services-to-be-removed-from-bse-indices-from-september-1-11289261.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240216194439/https://www.moneycontrol.com/europe/?url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/jio-financial-services-to-be-removed-from-bse-indices-from-september-1-11289261.html |archive-date=2024-02-16 |access-date=2024-02-17 |website=Moneycontrol}}{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2023-08-24 |title=Why Jio Financial Services shares are hitting lower circuit everyday - Explained |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/why-jio-financial-services-shares-are-hitting-lower-circuit-everyday-deepak-shenoy-explains-11692865949663.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230826131832/https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/why-jio-financial-services-shares-are-hitting-lower-circuit-everyday-deepak-shenoy-explains-11692865949663.html |archive-date=2023-08-26 |access-date=2024-02-16 |website=mint |language=en}}{{Cite web |date=2023-09-04 |title=The index fund attack on Jio Financial Services is over. extract: Jio Financial Services Ltd (JFSL) is an Indian financial services company, based in Mumbai. Originally a subsidiary of Reliance Industries (RIL), it was demerged as an independent entity and listed on the Indian stock exchanges in August 2023. The company provides financial services, including payment services and insurance broking. Its subsidiary Jio Finance holds an NBFC license from the RBI. Another subsidiary, Jio Payments Bank, is also a payments bank registered in India.
